topics.title: Write about a person who positively affected your personality and your life.
guiding_questions: Why is he/she special to you?
topics.sample_essay: My mother is the person who changed my life. She is kind and patient. She taught me to be honest and brave. When I was sad, she always helped me. She showed me how to love reading. Now I study hard every day. She made me a better person. I want to be like her.

topics.title: Write a letter to a pen pal who is living abroad.
guiding_questions: Who are you and how old are you?
Where do you live and study?
What do you like to do?
What do you want to know about him/her?
What do you want to tell him/her about your country?
topics.sample_essay: Hi Emma, my name is Omar. I am fourteen. I live in Syria. I study at a very nice school. I like football and reading. I want to know about your city and school. I want to tell you about my country. We have old places and good food too. Please write back soon. Omar.
